svg.title: S3. Lock-in fingerprints by sector
svg.text: S3. Lock-in fingerprints, sector by sector
Gray band: what a pure-chance world with the same amendment counts produces (mean ± 2 SD). Dot: observed. Filled orange = significantly above chance; open = within or below.
Tier 1: vendor-level design + escalation (lock-in). Tier 2: vendor-level design only. Tier 3: neither. Within tier, ordered by escalation; thin sectors last. Acceleration is supporting only.
Vendor share separates design (gap or lock-in worlds) from chance and routine renewals; escalation separates lock-in. Acceleration appears only if dependence grows without limit.
